$comment: noEmitOnError is load-bearing, not tidiness. tsc emits by default even when
type checking fails, and several gates import package dist/ output. A failed
build therefore used to leave importable JavaScript behind, so the next gate
run read artifacts from a build that did not succeed and reported PASS. That
is the paper's fabricated-evidence failure in the Node half of the repo: a
claim resting on evidence the run never produced. With this set a failed
build leaves nothing to import and the gate fails loudly instead.
